newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mobil to sell some Australian assets.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mobil to sell some Australian assets.

text.p: Mobil Corp unit Mobil Exploration and Producing Australia Pty Ltd (MEPA) said on Tuesday that it planned to sell some of the Australian assets owned by the Ampolex group of companies acquired last year.
MEPA also said it expected to invest more than A$1 billion in upstream oi and gas projects in Australia over the next ten years.

The main assets for sale included a 25 percent interest in the Harriet oil and gas complex, and a 35 percent interest in the East Spar gas condensate field, both offshore Western Australia, MEPA said.
"These are quality asets," said chairman and managing director Dan Haworth in a statement.
"However, they are not core to MEPA's future in Australia."
Haworth said the sale did not represent a lessening of MEPA's commitment to Western Australia, but was part of a review of its investments.
MEPA gained its stakes in the Harriet and East Spar fields through the 1996 takeover of independent oil and gas explorer and producer Ampolex Ltd for A$1.78 billion.

MEPA was seen as chiefly interested in Ampolex's 14.3 percent stake in the giant Gorgon gas field offshore Western Australia, and its share of the Kutubu oil field in Papua New Guinea and the adjacent Gobe oil field.
